title: Read Between the Lines: A Benchmark for Uncovering Political Bias in Bangla News Articles

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating 28 large language models on a benchmark dataset of 200 Bangla news articles annotated for political stance (government-leaning, government-critique, and neutral). Models are prompted to classify the articles and provide reasoning, with evaluations focusing on F1-scores, confusion matrices, and bias tendency distributions to detect over-prediction of specific political stances.
